name: Feature Showcase
description: Alternating image-and-text feature rows that flip left and right down the page, each pairing a captioned visual with a headline, supporting copy, a checklist, and a call to action.
usage: Import FeatureShowcase and render <FeatureShowcase /> (or pass your own `eyebrow`, `heading`, `intro`, and `features` array). For plain HTML, copy the <section> from section.html into any Tailwind page. The preview.html file renders the HTML variant standalone via the Tailwind Play CDN.
